Latin word

dubitō

dubitō, dubitāre, dubitāvī, dubitātum

verb, first conjugation

doubt, be unsure; hesitate (to do something)

In this lexicon

  • doubt

    the recommended word · classical · Cic. Off. 1.30: quod dubitēs aequum sit an inīquum; Traupman 97, 306

  • hesitate

    the recommended word · classical · Cic. Sen. 25: nec vērō dubitat agricola … respondēre; Caes. B.G. 2.23.2 (Lewis & Short)

Examples

  • quōcircā bene praecipiunt quī vetant quicquam agere quod dubitēs aequum sit an inīquum

    so they advise well who forbid us to do anything when we are in doubt whether it is fair or unfairCic. Off. 1.30
